name: BRAND TEXT
description: Powerjoin Industrial Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer and exporter, specializing in small electrical appliances, household appliance. Powerjoin has our own investment department, and now we owned one factory and invested two cooperated factories, one of which is in Ningbo, and the other is in Shunde. After several years' development, Powerjoin has had the ability of producing a variety of electrical home appliances, such as coffee makers, bread makers, vacuum cleaners, steam irons, deep fryers, and so on, and also our products have CE, GS, RoHS, UL, ETL, LMBG certificates.Now, our factories have about 500 workers in our two factories, and the output per day can achieve above 5000pcs. Besides as a sales department, Powerjoin Shanghai office also does products' sourcing for other famous International companies. We boast good reputation in sourcing service and inspection service. Good experience and efficient team guarantee good products with best price and high qualit.Details]
